newsitem.title: CANADA: XCan denies rumoured canola sale to German crusher.
newsitem.headline: XCan denies rumoured canola sale to German crusher.

text.p: XCan Grain Pool Ltd denied market rumours it sold 18,000 tonnes of canola seed to a German crusher for November-December shipment.

"I would have loved to have made the sale because we need the cash movemement but the feedback from Europe was my offer was too expensive and it is illegal at this stage to import transgenic canola into Europe," XCan canola trader Joe Toens told Reuters.

New crop canola futures on the Winnipeg Commodity Exchange held relatively firm to CBOT's soycomplex in part due to the XCan rumour and expectations of higher acreage seeded to canola this spring, traders said.
WCE November canola fell C$2.00 a tonne to C$367.50 at 1125 CST/1725 GMT while Chicago Board of Trade November soybeans fell US$0.0725 to US$6.96 on commercial selling.
Three sources said XCan bought at least 18,000 tonnes of canola seed from United Grain Grower's Thunder Bay terminal Thursday for November-December shipment between US$290-US$305/tonne FOB.
Toens confirmed he purchased one cargo load from UGG.
Toens said he believed the European Union would likely soon revise its ban on transgenic canola imports, as it has done for transgenic soybean imports.
